summary: Restored canonical evidence for all six proposed facts and all handoff non-retain claims, including the previously missing mplib.c L4091-L4137 endpoint traversal receipt. Reconciled hash-bound proposal and functionality document; no semantic correction required. Accepted upstream deferrals remain unchanged.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical selection, C-stick threshold, and CliffWait caller confirm inclusive axis qualification, immediate left-stick return, latch arming, and subsequent timeout handling.
The exact angular predicate, latch guards, cooldown write, return paths, and absence of finite-value checks match source. Floating boundary statements retain their stated assumptions.
Entry sequence and both callback-table bindings are confirmed. Completion explicitly branches on GA_Air; physics and ceiling handling provide earlier exits.
Collision dispatch, grounding wrapper, and ceiling helper confirm argument flow and priority. False is a branch condition, not a forwarded argument; no direct Fighter writes occur in this callback.

Restored mplib.c L4091-L4137 independently confirms previous-chain v0 and next-chain v1 endpoints. Validation distinguishes false results from malformed-ID loops; positioning, grounding guards, and possible grounding assertion match source.
The TU summary agrees with verified input, entry, completion, physics, and collision paths without claiming unconditional grounded completion or universal invalid-geometry fallback.
